H2_calibration.quote: 18 U.S.C. 1001 may apply to false statements, but not to silence
H2_calibration.note: also: a single deployment or a training run that completes in one day could be argued to be a one-day violation

H4_grandfather_step.quote: A developer can start a run the day before enactment and continue it indefinitely, or claim any later work is "continued training" of a grandfathered model.
